column1: # tests/rulecheck/ledger.tsv — THE RULE-CHECKER'S LEDGER: one row per run, append-only
# tests/test_rule_checker.sh). Written by `rulecheck record` and `rulecheck resolve`
#   id              <date>-<nn>, the run dir under tests/rulecheck/runs/
#   date            the day the verdict was recorded
#   session         the 14z-N key of the sitting
#   decision        build | freeze | expectation | recommendation | calibration
#   subject         what the action is about (freeze: the expectation sets, space-separated;
#   control         the fixture PLANTED beside the real packet (calibration: the fixture itself)
#   control_verdict CAUGHT | DEAD — whether the plant's expected violation was returned
#   verdict         OK | VIOLATED | VOID (VOID when the plant was DEAD: the run licenses nothing)
#   violated        the questions VIOLATED on the real packet, or -
#   resolution      - until a VIOLATED run's stop is resolved; then one line saying what changed
#   model           the model the checker agents ran on, as given to `prepare --model`
